title: Preserve draft history and detect structural content loss
objective: Extend existing approval metadata additively under the existing phase lock; immutable version files remain authoritative.
description: V59: V59-RQ-01, V59-RQ-06, V59-RQ-07. Preserve draft history and detect structural content loss.
parallel_safe_reason: Disjoint draft/Brain module writes after all-spec audit; coordinator serializes shared registry integration.
must: Extend existing approval metadata additively under the existing phase lock; immutable version files remain authoritative.
Compute preservation using requirement/acceptance/slice IDs, structured required collections and references. Compare identity, not word-count thresholds.
Persist defective candidates as corrupted and retain last valid current, with explicit diagnostics and transactional recovery marker for multi-file projection.
Expose lifecycle draft/current/reviewed/approved/approved-with-conditions/rejected/superseded/corrupted without treating current selection as approval.

Existing planning writers consume the selected/integrity result: an unselected or corrupted candidate must not advance phase or replace the run's valid current artifact. Scope ai.js to this existing writer boundary; new CLI namespace remains slice-04.
Update affected legacy plaintext test fixtures to real stable AC/slice IDs while preserving assertion intent and invalid-shape cases; never add a test-only bypass or disable a failing test.
not_included: Forged evidence, reduced acceptance or discarded history
acceptance: Candidate drops a required ID or structured collection: corrupted, current/history unchanged.
Valid addition or explicit deletion amendment: no false content-loss claim.
Crash between writes, corrupt metadata, duplicate version and competing writer fail closed or recover deterministically.
